issue_context.title: STM32WL ADC idles / doesn't work
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The STM32WL on the LoRa E5 Dev Board fails to read from the ADC with the example code in PlatformIO.

Please also mention any information which could help others to understand
the problem you're facing:
 - Zephyr v2.7.1
 - Ran in debug mode to step through to see where it gets stuck but end up looping through lines 93-99 of `idle.c` (this may be normal - I'm very new to Zephyr)

**To Reproduce**
Source code [here](https://github.com/nobodywasishere/ee193/tree/main/03-adc/zephyr-adc)
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. `pio run -t upload`, build and upload to the device
2. `picocom --baud 115200 /dev/ttyUSB0` connect to the device over serial
3. Press reset, will simply say 'Looping...' and nothing else
4. Running in debug mode, it gets into a loop

**Expected behavior**
Prints out the values of the ADC to the serial monitor.

**Impact**
Severe annoyance (will have to figure out how to use ADC manually)

**Logs and console output**

[PlatformIO clean/build/upload log](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/files/8127984/upload.log)

```
$ picocom --baud 115200 /dev/ttyUSB0 

picocom v3.1

...

Type [C-a] [C-h] to see available commands
Terminal ready
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v20701  ***
Looping...
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Arch Linux
 - Toolchain: Zephyr PlatformIO
 - Version: v2.7.1

**Additional context**

Similar to #37352 but I have CONFIG_PM disabled.
